name: Project B-FER
source:
You and 4 other people are trapped underground on a moving subway train. What are you willing to do to get out? Will you play by the rules, or break them?

Built in a few weeks for a livestream audience, Team Streamcope brings you a short puzzle game inspired by the Zero Escape series!

Meet a colorful cast of characters and join forces with them to solve the mysteries left behind by the enigmatic Butcher. Logic, think, and break your way out of their riddles, and escape the subway you have been trapped in!

[from [url=https://streamcope.itch.io/project-b-fer]itch.io[/url]]
